summary_en: 270,000 shares (7.3% of shares outstanding) to be acquired via ToSTNeT-3 on 2026-08-10 at ¥1,723/share (today's close), upper limit ¥465.2M. Single-tranche block within authorized program (320,000 shares, ¥640M, 2026-08-10 to 2026-10-31).
title_en: Notice of Acquisition of Own Shares via Off-Hours Market Trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: Asahi Pen Corporation filed a notice on 2026-08-07 of a single-block acquisition of its own shares to be executed the following business day. The company will place a buy order on 2026-08-10 at 08:45 JST via ToSTNeT-3 (off-hours trading on the Tokyo Stock Exchange) at the day's closing price of ¥1,723/share, with an upper limit of 270,000 shares and a maximum outlay of ¥465.21 million. This block represents 7.3% of shares outstanding (excluding treasury). The order is valid only during the specified one-hour trading window; execution is subject to market conditions and the availability of sell orders. The acquisition is part of a broader board-authorized program adopted the same day to acquire up to 320,000 shares (¥640 million) over the period 2026-08-10 to 2026-10-31 using market purchases including ToSTNeT-3. Results will be announced after the trading window closes.
